# The MVP guest pins (planning/mvp-m0-plan.md, Guest software, Budgets, and
# Tests and evidence; B7's guest/pins.txt with the MVP's outputs): the
# SHA-256 and size of the nolibc init, the Image, and every DTB that
# tools/build-guest.sh makes, the Image header facts, and the kernel
# banner, which both QEMU reference boots printed. They hold for the cross
# toolchain named on the last line. tools/guest-pins.py checks them;
# `build-guest.sh --unpinned` prints the lines for a deliberate update.
